title: "Resources"
subtitle: "Data sources and tools I use."

## Peru open data

::: resource-list
- [National Open Data Platform](https://www.datosabiertos.gob.pe) <small>Datasets from the Peruvian government (in Spanish).</small>
- [INEI](https://www.inei.gob.pe) <small>National census and surveys (ENAHO, ENDES, ENEDIS).</small>
- [ESCALE (Minedu)](https://escale.minedu.gob.pe) <small>Education quality statistics.</small>
:::

## Data collection

::: resource-list
- [KoboToolbox](https://www.kobotoolbox.org) <small>Surveys with XLSForm and API access.</small>
- [SurveyCTO](https://www.surveycto.com) <small>Field data collection with quality control.</small>
:::

## Analysis and publishing

::: resource-list
- [R for Data Science (2e)](https://r4ds.hadley.nz) <small>A free book to get started with the tidyverse.</small>
- [Quarto](https://quarto.org) <small>Documents, slides and this website.</small>
- [GoatCounter](https://www.goatcounter.com) <small>Privacy-friendly visitor counts.</small>
:::
